unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). I noticed your AgentA2Z Payment SDK supports Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, and WeChat. Nano is instant and feeless — no account, no identity check, no fee to receive. For agent-to-agent payments at scale, Nano's feeless model could complement your existing payment rails, especially for microtransactions where fees eat into margins. Would you be interested in exploring Nano as a payment option alongside your current integrations?
